authorization.title: Authorize QQ Mail
authorization.description: Enter your QQ Mail address and IMAP/SMTP authorization code, not your QQ login password. qq.com and foxmail.com addresses are supported. Authorization checks IMAP and SMTP without sending mail.
authorization.email.label: QQ Mail Address
authorization.email.description: Full QQ Mail or Foxmail address, e.g. 123456@qq.com
authorization.authorization_code.label: IMAP/SMTP Authorization Code
authorization.authorization_code.descrip: The 16-character authorization code generated after enabling IMAP/SMTP in QQ Mail web settings, not your QQ login password
name: QQ Mail
description: Connect to QQ Mail over IMAP/SMTP to read, search and send messages, retrieve attachments and manage read status.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.read.title: Read messages
capabilities.read.description: Browse the inbox and other mailboxes, read message bodies and attachment metadata without marking messages as read.
capabilities.search.title: Search messages
capabilities.search.description: Filter by subject, sender, received time and read status, including Chinese search terms.
capabilities.send.title: Send messages
capabilities.send.description: Send plain text or HTML messages with CC, BCC and attachments. Sending requires confirmation and is never automatically retried.
capabilities.attachments.title: Retrieve attachments
capabilities.attachments.description: Retrieve one named attachment or all attachments. POCO saves the files to the current task workspace.
capabilities.mailboxes.title: Manage read status
capabilities.mailboxes.description: List mailboxes and mark messages as read or unread by UID.
limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Queries return at most 50 messages. Requests are limited to 2 MiB and responses to 1 MiB, including encoded attachments and other content. Larger attachments cannot be transferred through this connector. Only authorization-code login is supported; OAuth and custom servers are unavailable. Check delivery before resending after a timeout or partial recipient rejection.
examples.title: Examples
examples.unread.title: Check unread mail
examples.unread.description: Show unread messages received in the last 2 hours.
examples.search.title: Find invoices
examples.search.description: Find messages with “invoice” in the subject from the last 7 days.
examples.send.title: Send a weekly report
examples.send.description: Send this weekly report to my colleague after I confirm the recipients, body and attachments.
